name: Inter-Facility Rebalancer
reads: Maps incoming ocean container, air ULD & rail car contents to urgent outbound orders Connected CPG systems: Manhattan WMS · SAP EWM · DMS Stock.
does: Bypasses high-bay storage by routing pallets straight from inbound strip door to outbound bay (Mathematical Optimization Solver (MILP / CP-SAT) CP-SAT Inbound-to-Outbound Door Coupling + Flow-Through Pallet De-Consolidation MILP).
returns: Aligns cross-dock sortation completion with FleetFlow & CubeMaster 3D truck departure slots Stages policy-checked action via Warehouse Management System (WMS / MCP) / Manhattan Cross-Dock Flow-Through Directive, Conveyor Sortation Route & Outbound Staging Lock.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved Manhattan WMS ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
